label: Ask the council for advice
notes: Free action. Triggers a minister briefing on a chosen domain.

label: Rule on a council dispute
notes: Pick a side in an active argument. Swings both ministers' opinion.

label: Recruit someone to court
notes: Draws from the candidate pool. Better candidates cost more and want more.

label: Reward a courtier
notes: Modes: gold title land marriage public_honour. Vain targets respond best.

label: Punish a courtier
notes: Modes: reprimand fine strip_title imprison exile execute. Escalates kin grievance.

label: Investigate a courtier
notes: Requires a Spymaster. Reveals hidden traits loyalty and faction membership.

label: Confide in a courtier
notes: Raises their opinion. A treacherous target may leak what you said.

label: Negotiate with a faction
notes: Concede all part or none of their demand. Partial splits moderates from radicals.

label: Buy off part of a faction
notes: Targets the least committed members. Cheaper than conceding to everyone.

label: Arrange a marriage at court
notes: Binds two courtiers. Creates a kinship link that transmits grievance.

label: Adjust your personal guard
notes: Direct reduction in assassination success chance. Ongoing upkeep.

label: Establish a new council seat
notes: One-off cost to open a seat beyond the founding five.

label: Buy a manor
notes: MANOR_SYSTEM.md §5. params: manor (code, label or cell id). Buys the manor from its house at MapManors.price_of; the house's people warm to the crown.

label: Sell a manor
notes: params: manor. Sells a crown manor back to its province's house at the sell-back price.

label: Build on a manor
notes: params: manor, building (data/manor_buildings.csv). Raises one building on a crown manor for its cost.

label: Seize a manor by force
notes: Skeleton: gated by manor_seize_enabled; automatic success until the military system resolves it. Costs legitimacy, unrest and the house's regard.
